diagram_math_checks.result: For x=(x0,x1) in R², the three real inner products are x0, x1, x0+x1, whose squares lie in [0,infinity)^3 and define I on Q2. Replacing x by -x negates each product, preserving the triple also at x=0 or with one zero coordinate. Independently, equality of triples gives z0²=x0², z1²=x1², and z0*z1=x0*x1 by subtracting the first two from the third. If both coordinates are nonzero their relative signs agree, forcing z=x or z=-x; if one is zero the other alone determines the same global-sign alternatives; if both are zero z=0. Thus no coordinatewise-sign or zero exception is introduced by the caption. These are checks of the already stated conclusion; original step 2.1 and its supplier remain unchanged.
